COBOL Coroner: static copy of real outputs

COBOL Coroner does not convert code. It verifies a migration that already exists, whoever produced it (an AI tool such as Kiro, another LLM, or a human).

This page is a static copy of real run outputs, for when the live site is unavailable. It contains no script and loads nothing from another site. Live site: https://coroner.iqoba.com. Repository: https://github.com/yarahmouni/cobol-coroner.

Detection Matrix

Each measured case has a faulty Java port and a correct one. Detected is the number of generated cases on which the faulty port diverged from COBOL. Rates depend on the generator settings of each case and are not real-world statistics. There is no global rate.

Case 1: The Missing Branch

The COBOL program fills its branch table in EBCDIC order. The faulty Java port matches branch codes in ASCII order, so some amounts are posted to suspense. The grand total still balances, which is why a total-only check does not see it. Both runs used the generated cases of seed 42.

Minimal failing case

Given the following input rows:
  CASE-ID=GEN-001525, BRANCH=001, AMOUNT=6253.54
When the COBOL reference and the Java port process this case
Then COBOL writes row BRANCH=001 with SUBTOTAL=+0006253.54, Java does not
Then Java writes row BRANCH=SUSP with SUBTOTAL=+0006253.54, COBOL does not
COBOL lines involved: samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:201 BALANCE-LINE.; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:202 MOVE 1 TO TABLE-INDEX; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:203 PERFORM UNTIL TABLE-INDEX > 9; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:204 IF TABLE-CODE(TABLE-INDEX) < TXN-BRANCH; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:205 ADD 1 TO TABLE-INDEX; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:207 IF TABLE-CODE(TABLE-INDEX) = TXN-BRANCH; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:208 ADD TXN-AMOUNT TO TABLE-SUBTOTAL(TABLE-INDEX); samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:209 ADD TXN-AMOUNT TO CASE-TOTAL; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:210 MOVE 10 TO TABLE-INDEX; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:218 IF TABLE-INDEX = 10; samples/traps/T1-ebcdic-match-merge/MATCH-MERGE.cob:219 CONTINUE

Replay a certificate

A certificate is a reproducible run record. Replaying it offline recomputes every file hash, regenerates the cases from the seed and runs COBOL and Java again. It is not a formal proof of equivalence.

Downloads

  • certificate-29c15f04407b.json (T1 correct port)
  • certificate-f584d5f35228.json (T1 faulty port)
  • cases-a1ad67c683af.csv (generated cases the certificates refer to)

Command, with the published image

The image is pinned by digest. The command needs Docker and the downloaded files in the current folder. It was not run during this build.

mkdir -p replay/runs/29c15f04407b
cp certificate-29c15f04407b.json replay/
cp cases-a1ad67c683af.csv replay/runs/29c15f04407b/generated_cases.csv
docker run --rm --init -v "$PWD/replay:/replay:ro" -e CORONER_BASE_DIR=/replay \
  ghcr.io/yarahmouni/cobol-coroner@sha256:0ca88a1f3cf795b08c2c8b9169efd1d05e276e593f22aaeafd7be082501a4ad4 \
  python3 -m coroner verify /replay/certificate-29c15f04407b.json
mkdir -p replay/runs/f584d5f35228
cp certificate-f584d5f35228.json replay/
cp cases-a1ad67c683af.csv replay/runs/f584d5f35228/generated_cases.csv
docker run --rm --init -v "$PWD/replay:/replay:ro" -e CORONER_BASE_DIR=/replay \
  ghcr.io/yarahmouni/cobol-coroner@sha256:0ca88a1f3cf795b08c2c8b9169efd1d05e276e593f22aaeafd7be082501a4ad4 \
  python3 -m coroner verify /replay/certificate-f584d5f35228.json

Expected first line of the output: Certificate: VALID. The exit code is 0 for an ALIVE certificate and 1 for a ZOMBIE certificate.
